findings.description: Phase 6 trigger detection uses git -C <repo_root> submodule status, but repo_root in Phase 6 IS the target repo (= prd.json.repoDir). When repoDir IS the submodule, the submodule-status check runs INSIDE the submodule and fails to prove it belongs to the wrapper. Must derive the wrapper root from <job_dir> (typically <wrapper>/.ralph/jobs/<name>/) or <group_dir>, then check repoDir relative to that wrapper root.
findings.resolution: Plan amended: Appendix D now derives wrapper_root from realpath of <job_dir>/../../.. (standalone) or <group_dir>/../../.. (group), validates the wrapper is itself a git repo, then runs git -C <wrapper_root> submodule status -- <relative_path_of_repoDir_from_wrapper_root>. AC-012 strengthened to verify both the wrapper-root derivation and the submodule-detection invocation.

findings.description: convert-to-ralph-prd batch mode currently skips the Explore agent (caller provides paths). implement-with-ralph autonomous Phase 2 passes --batch. The plan does not specify how --target-repo interacts with batch mode: must --target-repo be accepted as a batch-mode flag, and how does it initialize target_repo and repoDir when --batch is also set?
findings.resolution: Plan amended: AC-004 strengthened to require --target-repo accepted in BOTH interactive AND batch modes of convert-to-ralph-prd. In batch mode, --target-repo provides the value that --branch/--worktree-path/--job-dir already imply (the caller is the authoritative source). Implementation note added to the convert-to-ralph-prd file row: 'In batch mode, --target-repo is required when the caller did not pre-validate the path; validation still runs via git rev-parse --show-toplevel.'

findings.section: Acceptance Criteria > AC-018 / Acceptance Criteria Bundle-level
findings.description: Verification set names node plugins/ralph/tests/run.mjs (auto-discovers test-*.mjs) and the Copilot parity scripts, but omits tests/test-submodule-worktree-init.sh — a bash contract test that guards submodule and worktree prose surfaces touched by this scope.
findings.resolution: Plan amended: new AC-019 added requiring bash test bash plugins/ralph/tests/test-submodule-worktree-init.sh to pass after both stories ship. AC-018 reworded to enumerate all four verification gates (node tests, bash test, generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs --check, check-copilot-parity.mjs).

findings.description: /implement-with-ralph --parallel skips Phase 2 (routes through Phase 1.7 decompose-plan), so the proposed --target-repo argument would be accepted by parsing but silently ignored in parallel mode. Plan must either reject the combination up-front or extend decompose-plan / batch conversion to carry the override.
findings.resolution: Plan amended: scope clarified to REJECT --parallel + --target-repo combination with an explicit error message: 'Error: --target-repo is incompatible with --parallel (decompose-plan owns per-member repo selection; file a follow-up scope for cross-repo parallel decomposition).'. New AC-020 verifies the rejection: 'When both --parallel and --target-repo are provided, /implement-with-ralph exits non-zero with the documented error message before invoking decompose-plan.' Extending decompose-plan to carry the override is explicitly listed as a deferred follow-up scope (ralph-orchestration-decompose-plan-target-repo-override).

findings.description: tests/run.mjs prints one summary row per test file, not per node:test case. The 'three passes' verifier won't be visible at the file-level run output.
findings.resolution: AC-007 verifier rewritten: 'Run node --test plugins/ralph/tests/test-target-repo-override.mjs for case-level TAP output; assert ok 3 - covering present-valid, present-non-repo, absent-regression cases. Also assert the file is auto-discovered by node plugins/ralph/tests/run.mjs (exit 0 + the file name appears in the summary row).'

findings.description: AC-002 can pass on three incidental 'target-repo' mentions without proving Phase 2 forwarding. AC-013 uses grep -A3 against a long bullet — a valid backlink placed under it may not appear within 3 lines.
findings.resolution: AC-002 tightened to: 'grep "convert-to-ralph-prd .*--target-repo" plugins/ralph/skills/implement-with-ralph/SKILL.md returns >=1 hit (proves Phase 2 forwarding wires through to the convert skill invocation).' AC-013 tightened to: 'grep -A20 "Always push main to ALL configured remotes after every merge" <wrapper>/AGENTS.md | grep -E "plugins/ralph/AGENTS\.md.*ceremony.*canonical" returns >=1 hit (backlink within 20 lines of the anchor, explicitly mentioning canonical/ceremony).'

findings.description: Plan mentions topic branch ralph/plan-ralph-v5.49-bundle (overview) AND ralph/ralph-orchestration-spawn-target-repo-override-flag (Next Step / spawn-prompt). The two names are confusing; an autonomous member may commit to the wrong branch.
findings.resolution: Plan amended: Overview section clarified — ralph/plan-ralph-v5.49-bundle is the PLAN-phase branch (this work, in codexu plan worktree); ralph/ralph-orchestration-spawn-target-repo-override-flag is the IMPL-phase branch (separate impl member, in ai-developer-toolkit submodule worktree). Next Step section adds explicit branch-mapping table.

findings.description: Validation example shows 'git -C "$path" rev-parse --show-toplevel >/dev/null 2>&1' which discards stdout. An implementer might validate then store the RAW user argument rather than the normalized canonical path. prd.json.repoDir requires absolute normalized path with forward slashes.
findings.resolution: Plan amended: file-row entries for both convert-to-ralph-prd/SKILL.md and implement-with-ralph/SKILL.md now require the validated git -C <path> rev-parse --show-toplevel STDOUT to be captured (not discarded), normalized to forward slashes via existing path-utils.mjs::normalizePath helper, and stored as the canonical target_repo. Explicit example: target_repo=$(git -C "$path" rev-parse --show-toplevel | node "$PLUGIN_DIR/src/path-utils.mjs" normalize-path -).

findings.description: AC-012 verifies static prose via grep but does not verify path tailoring, trigger behavior, or output destination. Also, implement-with-ralph Phase 6 emits terminal markers (<ralph-orchestrator>COMPLETE</ralph-orchestrator>) and writes to dashboard.md / progress.txt — NOT crews mailbox kind=done reports. The plan's 'kind=done report body' framing is the wrong layer (crews is the wrapper, not what SKILL.md writes to).
findings.resolution: Plan amended: Appendix D rewritten so the handoff prose is APPENDED to Phase 6 stdout output (before the COMPLETE marker) and ALSO appended to progress.txt under a '## Orchestrator Notes > Submodule ship handoff' section. AC-012 verifier strengthened: (a) grep checks both stdout-echo command AND progress.txt append are present in SKILL.md; (b) plan adds a manual verification path describing a fixture where repoDir = subdirectory of wrapper_root + verifying the prose appears in the simulated terminal output. Crews-layer framing removed from the plan (the impl-member's own crews wrapper will surface the prose via its own kind=done emission, but that's outside the SKILL.md contract).

findings.description: Plan targets v5.49.0 but current is 5.47.0 and the natural sequential bump is 5.48.0. The data.json prompts say 'v5.49.0 candidate'. The ambiguity is not resolved in-plan and the impl member may bump to either depending on interpretation.
findings.resolution: Plan amended: Open Question #1 tightened with concrete decision gate. Impl member MUST run a check on first turn: cd ai-developer-toolkit && grep -rE '"5\.48\.[0-9]+"' plugins/ralph/CHANGELOG.md plugins/ralph/.claude-plugin/plugin.json plugins/ralph/.github/plugin/plugin.json .claude-plugin/marketplace.json .github/plugin/marketplace.json .agents/plugins/marketplace.json — if ANY hit, v5.48 IS taken, bump to 5.49.0 (matches operator brief). If NO hit, surface kind=question to operator asking whether to use 5.48.0 (sequential) or 5.49.0 (matches bundle name); default 5.49.0 if no response.
